column1: # stick/img-swap.tsv: what a refresh may change in each image's OS file systems (docs/design/img-speed.md
# §1.3, C2): PLATFORMS, TREE, PATH (fnmatch), KIND (bin, marker, id, rewritten) [optional].  TREE is a name
# of the tree listing (img_inputs.py tree-list; os-tree.txt beside each image): linux iso and layer; the
# four BSDs root; illumos stick (s2) and archive (boot_archive.gz); haiku bfs.  The OS manifest is the
# listing without these paths; a full build's provenance checks that every path not marked optional is
# in its listing (swap_missing).  The layout, partition table, boot code and ESP are not listed here:
# C2 compares them byte for byte, the config partition aside.  Tree `layout` (img_inputs.py layout: the
# MBR and GPT, each partition's bytes, the system area, the El Torito images, positions and ids masked)
# names the GPT partitions a refresh rewrites, /gpt/part/N; layout rows never enter the OS manifest.
# Linux's /boot.catalog holds only the boot images' positions, which move with the layer's size: the
# layout compares it with those masked.
